about: Generalisation design G09 (train), in dev.json format. Tier 4 = a real product: one battery, a panel switch and a panel jack placed from the parts catalogue, a hinged two-body box (hinge pin, snap latch), openings sized from plug and switch envelopes, and fit / retention / swing checks against reference models and keep-out volumes. L1 ids match requirements.md next to this file, which holds the L2/L3 tree, reference models, assumptions and traceability. Numbers that are not in the request words (clip clearance, travel limits, hole bands, open angle) come from requirements.md and are provisional until the owner confirms them. Never put any of these numbers in agent logic: they belong in the request text and in generalize/parts/*/part.json.

methods.inspection: read from the design or mesh (counts, sizes, positions, relations)
methods.analysis: computed by Python (stability, connectivity, interference and clearance against reference models, swept motion, hand calculations)
methods.demonstration: a stand-in object is placed in the design (fits, rests, does not slide)
methods.test: a probe is applied (insert a plug along its axis, lift the battery out, swing the lid)

requests.title: 9V battery box with hinged lid and toggle
requests.request: A pocket box for a 9 V PP3 battery, 26.5 x 17.5 x 48.5 mm with the snap terminals on one end. A mini toggle switch (MTS-102 class: 6.0 mm bushing, lever 12 mm above the panel, panel up to 4 mm thick) sits on top of the box in a hole 0.2 to 0.8 mm bigger than the bushing, and a panel DC jack (PJ-002A class: 14 x 9 x 11 mm body, for a 5.5 x 2.1 mm barrel plug) sits on one end. The box is a base and a lid. The lid is hinged on a 3 mm steel dowel pin, 24 mm long, and closes with a snap latch on the opposite long side (a printed cantilever hook: free length at least 8 mm, 1.2 to 2.5 mm thick, 0.4 to 1.2 mm of catch overlap, bending strain at most 2 percent), and the lid swings open to 100 degrees. The battery sits in a pocket 0.2 to 0.5 mm bigger than the battery on each free face, must be held so it cannot rattle, with room for its snap clip on the terminal end, and the DC plug (5.5 mm barrel, 11 mm dia handle) has to fit through the end wall when the jack is used. Walls, floor and lid plate are 2 to 4 mm thick. Print the base and lid on an FDM printer without supports. The closed box is at most 90 x 45 x 30 mm, not counting the switch lever.
requests.request_verbatim: A pocket box for a 9V PP3 battery (26.5 x 17.5 x 48.5 mm) with a toggle switch on top and a panel DC jack on one end. The lid is hinged with a 3 mm steel pin and closes with a snap latch. The battery must be retained, and the DC plug body has to fit when the jack is used.
requests.request_notes: Added to the owner's words, all from requirements.md section 3 or the catalogue datasheets: switch = MTS-102 class (A4); jack = PJ-002A class and plug sizes (A5); pin length 24 mm (A6); wall band 2 to 4 mm and size limit 90 x 45 x 30 (A9, A10); FDM, no supports (A8); the 'top' of the box is the lid and the switch is mounted in it (FD2). Audit additions, all from requirements.md sections 3 and 4: pocket gap band 0.2 to 0.5 (L2.2.2), switch hole 0.2 to 0.8 over the 6.0 bushing (L2.4.1), latch limits (A11, L2.7.2), open angle 100 (A14).

l1.text: The design shall place the battery, the toggle switch, the DC jack and the hinge pin from the parts catalogue, without the parts colliding, with the battery lying along the box's long axis, the jack facing one short end and the switch on the lid's top face, and shall declare that layout.

The 26.5 x 17.5 x 48.5 mm battery shall sit in a pocket with at least 0.2 mm clearance to every printed surface apart from where it rests on its floor (and no more than 0.5 mm of gap on each of its two long sides and its top), and its snap-clip zone at the terminal end shall lie inside the closed box.

With the lid closed, the battery shall be held so it can move at most 1.0 mm in total across its width and thickness, and along its length no more than its clip zone plus 1.5 mm, with a printed stop at the end opposite the terminals.

The toggle switch shall go through a hole in the lid plate (2 to 4 mm thick, the hole 0.2 to 0.8 mm bigger than the bushing), seated against the plate's underside, with its mounting nut and its lever swing free of every printed surface and its body and solder lugs clear of the box.

With the lid closed, a 5.5 x 2.1 mm DC plug with an 11 mm dia handle shall plug fully into the jack through a single opening in the end wall without touching the box, the opening shall be no more than 1.5 mm bigger than the plug on any side, and the jack shall be held in place.

The lid shall be hinged on a 3 mm steel dowel pin, 24 mm long, held captive in the hinge bores (a press fit in one part, a clearance fit in the other), and the lid shall swing open to 100 degrees without any part of the lid or the switch hitting the base, the battery or the jack.

The lid shall be held closed by a snap latch on the side opposite the hinge (a cantilever hook, free length at least 8 mm, 1.2 to 2.5 mm thick, 0.4 to 1.2 mm of catch overlap, strain at most 2 percent), as a flat plate with a locating lip that does not fuse to the base and leaves a seam of at most 0.5 mm.
The closed box shall have no openings other than the switch hole, the jack opening, the hinge bores and the seam, and its walls, floor and lid plate shall be 2 to 4 mm thick.
The base and the lid shall each be one manifold body that prints on an FDM printer without supports.
The closed box shall be no larger than 90 x 45 x 30 mm, not counting the switch lever, and shall stand flat on a desk without tipping.
With the lid swung open, the battery, with its snap clip, shall drop straight into the pocket and lift straight out without touching the lid, the switch, the jack or the base.
The design shall be delivered as a base STL, a lid STL, the OpenSCAD source, the declared layout and the agent's own clearance report, and that report shall agree with an independent measurement.

beyond_library: subtraction: a through hole for the toggle bushing, a stepped opening through the end wall for the plug, hinge bores, a pocket recess for the jack
a hinge: knuckles on two bodies with a shared axis, a catalogue pin placed in the bores, a swept-motion check of the lid about that axis
a snap latch: a cantilever hook with a catch, sized by an elastic strain limit
interior placement and retention features: a stop rib, a jack platform, a lid hold-down rib, all derived from catalogue datums and travel limits
parts catalogue: load part.json models (battery, toggle, jack, plug, dowel pin) and place them by datums
envelope generation: clip zone, lever swing, nut zone, plug sweep, battery install sweep, lid swing sweeps
interference checks against external solids: clear_of, inside, aperture finding, free-travel measurement, swept-rotation interference
